name: age
description_en: Graph database optimized for fast analysis and real-time data processing. It is provided as an extension to PostgreSQL.
readme_excerpt: is a leading multi-model graph database Graph Processing & Analytics for Relational Databases             What is Apache AGE? Apache AGE is an extension for PostgreSQL that enables users to leverage a graph database on top of the existing relational databases. AGE is an acronym for A Graph Extension and is inspired by Bitnine's AgensGraph, a multi-model database fork of PostgreSQL.
